1879-4289-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3755-6920--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-6920--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Silk triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2395-4452-4508-7863--165.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
"Pirate" chosen with Rukarumel.
2395-4452-4508-7863--165.description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcom triggers due to Rukarumel, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Quicksmith Genius, causing you to draw a card and discard a card.
Repeat from step 2.

803-3899-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
803-3899-4302.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1379-2919-4186-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-2919-4186-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

412-2292-3081-3817.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ancestor's Chosen.
When Ancestor's Chosen dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Ancestor's Chosen from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
When Ancestor's Chosen enters, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each card in your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

740-3587-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
740-3587-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Boros Reckoner indestructible using Grand Crescendo.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
740-3587-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

6458-6996-7690--165.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
6458-6996-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-661-3685-4659.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {3}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Sculpting Steel. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-5256-5470-7296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

3259-5659-7297.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5659-7297.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-628-7187.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Hovel Hurler.
When Hovel Hurler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Hovel Hurler enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

643-2292-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
643-2292-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1308-1648-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1308-1648-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa of Shadowed Boughs
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2203-2366-5223-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2203-2366-5223-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6199-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Marionette Apprentice.
When Marionette Apprentice dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Apprentice enters, its fabricate ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Marionette Apprentice trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

620-2604-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-2604-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

2854-4574-4708-6918.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-4574-4708-6918.description:
Cast Dark Sphere either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

934-3767-3918-3941.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a Spider you control without summoning sickness
attached to the Spider that has Thornbite Staff attached

188-1729-2178.description:
Activate the Spider with Thornbite Staff and Lavamancer's Skill attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls and destroying it due to the Spider's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Shelob and the Spider tapped in step 1 trigger.
Resolve the Shelob trigger, creating a token copy of the creature that died that is a Food artifact.
Resolve the Spider trigger, untapping it.
Repeat as desired. You can also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2086-5686-6824.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

560-1563-2457-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insect and Soldier by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2511-6014-6659.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another modified creature.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters the battlefield, Gylwain triggers, creating a Role token attached to the manifested creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

618-3719-6243.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Ruthless Technomancer with haste.
When the Ruthless Technomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kiki-Jiki and create two Treasure tokens,
When Kiki-Jiki dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Ruthless Technomancer with haste.
When the Ruthless Technomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kiki-Jiki and create three Treasure tokens,
Activate thee Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate a Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1336-3995-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1336-3995-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Heronblade Elite's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

527-3967-5140.manaNeeded: {G}, plus {R} if Selvala has summoning sickness
527-3967-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater that isn't Selvala.
527-3967-5140.description:
If Selvala has summoning sickness, activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving all creatures haste until end of turn.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
527-3967-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

248-1082.description:
Cast Changeling Berserker by paying {3}{R}.
When Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Dual Nature's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Changeling Berserker.
When the Changeling Berserker token enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Changeling Berserker.
Dual Nature's second ability triggers, exiling the Changeling Berserker token.
When the Changeling Berserker token leaves the battlefield, the nontoken Changeling Berserker is returned to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control additional creatures you wish to blink, you may resolve the Changeling Berserker trigger in step 2 to exile them, and then proceed with the combo.

2760-2842-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
There is at least one other creature on the battlefield.
2760-2842-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any other creature and causing you to draw a card.
If the creature who had the counter placed has 0 toughness, it dies as a state-based action.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat until your opponents do not control any more creatures, or until you draw your library.
If you have cards remaining in your library, you may repeat this combo any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2178-5220-5256-5615.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to The Master.
The Master does not have summoning sickness.
You control another creature with power 1 or greater.
2178-5220-5256-5615.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and The Master trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Master trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill the creature from your library.
Activate The Master by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Elbrus, the Binding Blade // Withengar Unbound

386-3693-4613-5506.easyPrerequisites: Glistening Oil attached to Withengar Unbound.
386-3693-4613-5506.notablePrerequisites:
Withengar Unbound does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Withengar Unbound, or cannot prevent at least ten trample damage from Withengar Unbound.
Walking Ballista exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
386-3693-4613-5506.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Withengar Unbound, causing them to get at least ten poison counters.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Withengar Unbound triggers, putting thirteen +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Withengar Unbound using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, giving an opponent a poison counter.
Repeat step 4 until the opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Repeat from step 3.

719-2837-5331.description:
Cast Gemcutter Buccaneer by paying {3}{R}.
When Gemcutter Buccaneer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Cat or 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Cat or Dog enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Xenograft, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Cat or 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat step 3.

575-1184-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kin-Tree Warden.
When Kin-Tree Warden dies, Yedora triggers, returning Kin-Tree Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Kin-Tree Warden's power.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

751-2653-3314-3478.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

678-2348-2882-3819-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Infinite Reflection attached to Cultivator Colossus.
678-2348-2882-3819-5256.description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield as a copy of Cultivator Colossus due to Nature's Revolt and Infinite Reflection.
When the land enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the land to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the land's power.
Resolve the land's trigger from step 3, causing you to put the land onto the battlefield from your hand, draw a card, and then decline to put another land onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

184-4682-4772.easyPrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
184-4682-4772.notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
184-4682-4772.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least six Treasure tokens due to Doubling Season.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

1298-3368-4280-5231.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, targeting the spell.
Veyran and Ovika each trigger twice.
Resolve both Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve both Ovika triggers, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens with haste.
Resolve Reiterate, creating a copy of the spell it was targeting and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Veyran triggers twice, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod six times by sacrificing the six Phyrexian Goblins, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

423-511-3510-4772.notablePrerequisites: Sporoloth Ancient has at least three spore counters on it.
423-511-3510-4772.description:
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
The Saprolings enter the battlefield as Forest lands due to Life and Limb, triggering Evolution Sage twice.
Resolve both Evolution Sage triggers, putting four spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.

1634-1860-3858-4690.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four basic lands.
1634-1860-3858-4690.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, allowing you to cast all spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast Phylath by paying {4}{R}{G}.
Phylath enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Devilish Valet.
Resolve the Phylath trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token for each basic land you control.
Each Plant token enters the battlefield, triggering Devilish Valet that many times.
Resolve a Devilish Valet trigger, doubling its power until end of turn.
Repeat step 7 for each remaining Devilish Valet trigger.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

891-1703-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fool's Demise's first and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise ability, doing nothing,.
Repeat.

2736-3158.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is about to lose the game due to lethal infect and/or commander damage.
2736-3158.description:
When an opponent is about to lose the game due to lethal infect and/or commander damage, before damage is dealt, activate Zedruu by paying {R}{W}{U}, giving the opponent about to lose the game control of Lich's Mirror.
When the opponent would lose the game, Lich's Mirror causes them to shuffle their hand, graveyard, and all permanents they own into their library, draw seven cards, and set their lifetotal to twenty.
Because they don't own Lich's Mirror, they retain control of it, and because infect/commander damage is not reset, they will then attempt to lose the game as a state-based action.
This creates a mandatory infinite loop, which ends the game in a draw.

3249-4242-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {R}.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Su-Chi.
Cast Su-Chi from graveyard by paying {4}.
Repeat.
